name: pipe_has_the_hole
why: ENTRY Z-C6. `extrude_profile` is in the catalogue with `Provata = true`, and until 24/9/2026 only three hand-written plans touched it (`bridge/c2_*`) which demand nothing. The case is that of the plan `c2_pipe_from_catalog`: two concentric circles, and the second must be a HOLE.
defect_caught: Two outlines one inside the other can be read in two ways: a ring (the second one removes) or two overlapping cylinders (the second one adds, and disappears inside the first). In the second case the part comes out SOLID, the rebuild is clean, and a 60x5 pipe becomes a 60 round bar. The volume tells them apart by a factor of three.

expect.tolerance_why: pi/4 * (60^2 - 50^2) * 100 = pi/4 * 1100 * 100 = 86393.798. The tenth covers the rounding; a SOLID pipe would give 282743.3 and a 60x4 pipe (Ø52 inside) 70371.7: the nearest wrong measure is sixteen thousand mm3 away.
extruded from the top plane, so along Y. Symmetric in X and Z, so the order does not depend on the direction
